inheritance: Apply all agent rules; this skill cannot suspend them.
objective: Identify candidate atomic ideas and their evidence.
steps: Find relevant definitions, arguments, distinctions, relationships, and observations.
Separate independently reusable ideas while respecting valid exceptions.
Combine excerpts about the same idea without creating new relationships.
Record the central idea, sources, relevance, dependencies, and state.
Detect duplicate candidates and record any merge or discard with a rationale.
Route uncertainties, missing elaboration, and isolated quotations to clarification.
forbidden_actions: Write the note body at this stage.
Create a note for every sentence without assessing relevance.
ask_when: Relevance depends on an intent that the source does not clarify.
completion_criteria: Every candidate has verbatim support and a routing decision.
